name: s6_carry_ladder_slide
title: The state is in the model's window and in both readers' words; shuffling the words removes it
caption: Exp 20, 160 selection items per row (80 vs 80): AUROC of a probe fit on the true layer-42 activations, applied frozen to the model's own activation over the last 32 tokens and to the critic's rebuild from the same 32 tokens shuffled, from Oracle Lens's free readout and from the NLA's explanation (k = 1). Oracle Lens is weakest on table column, parentheses and call argument; the two Markdown rows (shaded) are not linearly present at layer 42. Bars: Hanley-McNeil 95% (no per-item scores saved; ignores clustering). Caveat: the critic is the NLA's own, so the NLA series is in distribution.
